meta.title: Tennessee Eastman Challenge Process
meta.source_document: Downs, J.J. & Vogel, E.F. (1993). A plant-wide industrial process control problem. Computers & Chemical Engineering 17(3), 245-255.
meta.extraction_method: hand-built seed model (Phase 0). Serves as the answer-key draft for scoring AI extraction in Phase 2
meta.tag_convention: ISA-5.1 letters + loop number. TE publishes XMEAS/XMV indices, not plant tags, so tag numbers are ASSIGNED by this project and the original index is kept as xmeas/xmv. Measurements are numbered 101-137 in XMEAS order; each control valve carries the loop number of the measurement its controller reads (data/te_control_loops.json), with its pre-2026-10-28 tag kept as former_tag. Controllers are listed under controllers.
meta.verification_note: Instruments and final elements were checked 2026-10-06 against the open TE source code (teprob.f) by scripts/verify_te_source.py: 36 confirmed, 1 corrected (TI-122 description). Report: out/te_source_check.md. Units, streams, directions and tag ownership are checked separately; see topology_verification_note.
meta.topology_verification_note: Units, streams, flow directions and tag ownership were checked 2026-10-13 against the simulator source (teprob.f, cross-checked with the revised TE code) by scripts/verify_te_topology.py: 51 confirmed, 4 corrected, 1 unresolvable. Report: out/te_topology_check.md. Physical tap positions, sizes and pipe routes are not in the source and remain unverified.
